mostWorthwhile.text: The workshop design giving makers control over tasks and the ability to stop unsafe work made the distinction between ownership and practical control concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final comparison was the least engaging: its conclusion about prosperity and different good lives felt fairly predictable.

surprise.text: The care comparison made clear that enjoyable making leaves demanding care and maintenance to be supported and shared.

arbitrary.text: The final link from maker control to a city not prescribing one good life felt somewhat broad, although its purpose was clear.

continue.text: I might continue for more concrete examples like the makers' control rights, though the predictable final comparison was less compelling.
